answer: A new clerk cannot collect by copying a badge. You lock 1.74 POA and moor one survey skiff at wharf slip D-11, then cut a vault notch whose depth encodes your address. For 13 hours the skiff drops an 18-byte sounding every 21 minutes; each drop folds the last hash into a fresh height and a signed delta tag. Harbor tally clerks replay the sounding tape against the lock tx and a public tide board. If two skiffs claim D-11, a sounding repeats, or any gap exceeds 29 minutes, 0.64 POA is slashed and D-11 stays dark for eleven epochs.
